title: Software Engineer
location: India, Karnataka, Bangalore; India, Telangana, Hyderabad
description:
Overview
Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 
 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform.​ 

​​The Fabric Platform Shell team is dedicated to creating the best SaaS data development environment on the web. Our mission is to build a simple yet fully functional developer environment that attracts and retains developers, ensuring that more solutions are built on Fabric and more consumers use it. We aim to provide a unified and extensible web experience that is easy to understand and navigate, enabling 1st and 3rd party workloads to onboard seamlessly. 

​​We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities
• As a Software Engineer on the Fabric Platform Shell team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and build world-class experiences for our customers. Your responsibilities will include: • Designing and building top-notch experiences for the Fabric Platform in browser environments. 
• Working on full stack and backend development to deliver comprehensive experiences. 
• Collaborating closely with UX & UI designers, product managers, program managers, and other engineers throughout the product feature development lifecycle. 
• Demonstrating technical leadership by identifying gaps and writing high-quality code. 
​Embody our culture and values 

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications 
​​• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python 
• 2+ years demonstrated expertise in web application development, including JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and at least one popular web frontend framework such as React, Vue, or Angular. 
​ 
Job Requirements: Other & Additional 
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: 
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
Preferred/Additional Qualifications 
​​• A passion for delivering modern, high-performance user experiences in browser environments. 
• Experience in building great developer and user experiences for modern analytics systems. 
• A deep curiosity and willingness to question the status quo. • High enthusiasm, integrity, ingenuity, results-orientation, and self-motivation in a fast-paced environment. 
• A love for tackling the next problem, the next experiment, and the next partnership. 
• Committed to work collaboratively, solve problems with teams across the world, and find win/win solutions. 
• A deep passion and empathy for customers, leading to innovative problem-solving

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the Role:

A Senior SDE at Razorpay is well-grounded - smart, quality-focused, product-thinking, and business-conscious. Not a mere coder. You bring strong technical context and the experience to build software that matters at scale. Engineering at Razorpay creates significant impact across the payments ecosystem. You are expected to influence the culture of the company - bring conviction, challenge the status quo, set the bar, and help the team grow. We are looking for engineers who are current - not just technically strong, but actively working in AI-augmented workflows. At Razorpay, AI is not a feature we are building toward - it is part of how we build today.

What You Will Build

- Scale Razorpay's payment infrastructure to get every Indian to pay online

- Shape REST APIs used by developers worldwide

- Contribute to open source and set standards for mobile payments

- Drive product and design discussions - not just implement them

- Brainstorm and create new directions in Razorpay's quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all

What We Are Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in technology

- Strong product design sense - you think about the user, not just the implementation

- Proficiency in any of: PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, or C++

- Ability to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and arrive at effective solutions

- Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general

- Ability to build a feature from scratch and drive it to completion independently

- Willingness to learn new technology - whatever lets you deliver the best product

- Clean, well-structured code as a default - with awareness of performance and time complexity trade-offs

AI fluency we expect:

- Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants - you use them actively, not occasionally

- Ability to decompose problems into structured, constrained prompts with clear expected outcomes

- Critical review mindset - you own every line of AI-generated code, spot hallucinations, incorrect assumptions, and security gaps

- Strong LLD depth before agent use - you design first, delegate second

- Awareness of where AI helps and where it fails - and the judgment to know the difference

Why This Role Is Different 

- Most companies say they want engineers who care about product. We actually mean it. You will influence product direction from day one - not just implement specs.

- No whiteboard coding. No obscure algorithm puzzles. Every round mirrors what you would actually do at Razorpay. If you have been doing the same thing for two years and want a reset - this role will challenge you in ways that are hard to find elsewhere.

Good to Have

- Weekend side projects or contributions to open source on GitHub

- Prior experience at a product company

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agentic frameworks

- Working knowledge of a backend programming language beyond your primary stack

- Experience designing systems for scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. 

Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

title: Software Engineer (3-5 years), Symphony
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will play a critical part in designing and building robust, highly scalable distributed systems. You will collaborate closely with product leadership, mentor junior team members, and take immense ownership of complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
- System Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web-based applications. Create architectural abstractions and technical contracts with a strict adherence to the separation of concerns.

- Problem Solving & High-Level Design: Drive solutions for high-level business and technical problems. Lead functional modeling, module decomposition, and system design initiatives.

- Architectural Evolution: Implement incremental changes to the existing architecture and conduct comprehensive impact analyses.

- Performance Optimization: Profile, tune, and improve performance across large-scale distributed systems.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business features into technical capabilities. Lead the execution of medium-sized projects and structure workflows into distinct phases to ensure predictable delivery.

- Stakeholder Alignment: Work with broader stakeholders to track the impact of deployed projects and features, proactively iterating on them for continuous improvement.

- Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers, foster a collaborative team culture, and promote engineering excellence.

Required Qualifications
- Education: B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of solving problems at scale.

- Programming Expertise: Extensive experience in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C, C++). Exceptional coding skills with the ability to fluently translate design into maintainable, scalable, and unit-tested code.

- Concurrency: Strong hands-on experience with multi-threading and concurrent programming.

- System Design: Deep expertise in Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and building intuitive module and class-level interfaces.

- Scale & Data Management: Proven experience building highly scalable business applications, handling complex business flows, and processing massive volumes of data.

- Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MySQL) as well as NoSQL technologies (e.g., HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike).

- Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform.

- Working Environment: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-growth, dynamic startup environment with high levels of ownership and commitment.

- Drive & Passion: A strong analytical mindset with a genuine passion for solving complex, real-world technical challenges.

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy
Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. title: Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY


You’ll deliver new product capabilities across our platform, working across the full stack — from database models to UI components — and owning features end-to-end. AI is central to how you’ll work: you’ll use AI-assisted development tools daily to accelerate your output, build AI-powered product experiences for our customers, and help establish the practices that make our team effective in this new operating model.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and improve APIs, microservices, and frontend experiences that power government agencies at scale

 - Own features end-to-end: collaborate with Product and Design to define the problem, build the solution, ship it, and monitor it in production

 - Build AI-powered product features — from intelligent data analysis and agent-driven workflows to AI-assisted user experiences that transform how government teams work

 - Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your workflow to accelerate coding, debugging, and documentation

 - Produce clean, well-documented code and conduct thorough reviews of both human-written and AI-generated code, with a sharp eye for the subtle failure modes each produces

 - Collaborate across the organization to translate business priorities into shipped features that drive customer success




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Have 12+ years of professional experience building scalable software in an agile environment

 - Have strong Full Stack experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React or similar) and backend development with NodeJS

 - Are comfortable working across the stack — frontend, backend, data layer — and shipping features end-to-end

 - Have built heavily utilized enterprise SaaS software

 - Actively use AI-assisted development tools and have a feel for when they accelerate you vs. when they lead you astray

 - Have experience building AI-powered product features: agents, AI-driven UX, workflow automation, or retrieval systems (direct ML/model training experience not required)

 - Have built APIs, designed database models (SQL and NoSQL), and worked with event-driven patterns

 - Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where new ideas ship daily, staying closely aligned to customer needs and outcomes

 - Demonstrated experience working directly with customers to improve product experiences

 - A track record of experimenting with new AI tools and bringing effective ones to your team

 - Track record of driving team improvement through mentoring and process innovation

 - Previous work in govtech, fintech, or regulated SaaS environments




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: AI Applied Software Engineer
description:
The job in short

We are transitioning away from siloed engineering roles toward T-shaped, AI-empowered web developers. As an Applied AI Software Engineer (Web), you will build user-centric web applications and banking solutions while utilizing AI-driven tools and agentic workflows to accelerate code delivery, testing, and system integrations.

Meet the job

- AI-Enabled Web Delivery: Actively leverage AI coding assistants, LLM workflows, and automated tooling to accelerate feature development across UI, backend services, and APIs.

- End-to-End Ownership: Deliver production-ready features for the Backbase Digital Banking and Wealth platforms—from Angular frontend components to backend microservice integrations.

- Modern Web Engineering: Write clean, testable, and maintainable TypeScript/Angular code utilizing Nx, RxJS, and the Backbase Design System.

- Quality & Performance: Design testable components, run unit/integration test suites, and uphold strict web accessibility (a11y), security, and performance standards.

How about you

- Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), RxJS, HTML5, and SASS/CSS frameworks. Familiarity with toolchains like Nx, npm, or Webpack is a plus.

- AI Exposure: Practical exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM-driven testing or refactoring workflows).

- Full-Stack Capability: Solid foundational knowledge of backend integrations, REST APIs, microservices, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Communication: Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills in an agile, multidisciplinary environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

ISV Ecosystem (Full-stack Senior SWE) Job Description 

About Okta:

Okta is The World’s Identity Company with a mission to free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce Identity and Customer Identity offerings enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are looking for lifelong learners who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

About the team:

As part of our vision to Free Everyone to Safely Connect to any Technology, Okta is investing to help B2B / Enterprise SaaS companies engage with their customers by leveraging the Okta Integration Network (OIN) platform. 

We are building an express capability that allows Auth0-built SaaS applications in the OIN to integrate with Identity Providers through a ‘federated’ connection in a seamless, and simplest manner. This allows the customers of Okta to install these B2B SaaS apps in their tenants using the fewest possible clicks, thus ensuring their satisfaction and retention.

Join us in building the next generation of a streamlined Partner journey within Okta, as we increase its footprint to even broader capabilities. 

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join an innovative and fast moving full-stack team to build a new set of developer-facing products to achieve this mission. We welcome personalities that are self-driven, think outside-the-box, take pride in shipping high quality software and most importantly kind.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

- Analyze/Refine Requirements with Product Management and other stakeholders by asking the right questions and driving clarity.

- Work with user experience designers and architects to scope and plan engineering efforts and dependencies.

- Develop secure and reusable components to enable other teams to easily implement UIs with rich and consistent look and feel.

- Develop APIs and SDKs that developers love. The target audience for this team’s roadmap is the developers working at the B2B Enterprise SaaS companies.

- Have a high bar for security, test-driven development, design reviews and code reviews while harboring a sense of urgency.

- Define long-term observability and reliability metrics for the systems/features that they own.  

 Required Skills, Attitude and Knowledge:

- Have 4-6 years of software development experience.

- Proficient in building scalable and performant applications with NodeJS (Typescript, JavaScript)

- Experience building highly responsive UI components using React

- An understanding of asynchronous programming, its quirks and workarounds

- Demonstrable knowledge of HTTP fundamentals with strong API Design skills.

- Have experience working with at least one of the database technologies - MySQL, Redis, or PostgreSQL.

- Experience working with at least one cloud-native system of scale (AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Experience with distributed systems patterns including caching, asynchronous processing etc. 

- Track record of delivering work incrementally to get feedback and iterating over solutions. 

- Have an infectious enthusiasm and bring the right attitude to the team regarding ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and customer focus.

- Excellent written communication skills, bringing structure to ambiguous concepts, and driving closure on them methodically using first principles.

Bonus:

- Existing knowledge of Identity Protocols such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML

- Existing knowledge of security engineering and application security

Education and Training:

- B.S. Computer Science or related field

title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.
The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.

What you’ll be doing
- Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
- Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
- Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
- Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
- Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
- Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
- Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
- Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

What we need to see
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
- Strong C programming and debugging skills.
- Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
- Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
- Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.

- Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
- Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
- Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
- Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
- Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
- Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

We are seeking a highly skilled T7 AI Engineer to join our engineering team in Hyderabad, India. This role combines hands-on AI/ML engineering with deep software development expertise to build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems at enterprise scale. You will design and implement AI-powered solutions — from LLM integrations and agentic workflows to ML pipelines and intelligent automation — while driving AI adoption and engineering excellence across teams.

AI/ML Engineering & Delivery
- Design, build, and deploy production AI systems including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-model orchestration, and intelligent automation
- Integrate large language model (LLM) APIs and AI/ML services into enterprise applications (GCP Vertex AI)
- Implement and optimize prompt engineering strategies, fine-tuning pipelines, embeddings, and vector search solutions
- Build and maintain AI orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or LlamaIndex
- Develop custom AI agents, tools, and autonomous workflows that solve real business problems

- Write clean, well-tested, production-ready code with a focus on maintainability and operational excellence
MLOps & AI Infrastructure
- Design and implement MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for reliable model deployment, versioning, and lifecycle management
- Configure and manage cloud-native AI infrastructure (AWS, GCP) including model serving, orchestration, and auto-scaling
- Implement observability for AI systems — monitoring model drift, token costs, latency, throughput, and quality metrics
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI model deployment, automated testing, and continuous evaluation
- Design for resilience: failover strategies, fallback models, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation
AI-Augmented Development
- Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) to dramatically accelerate development workflows
- Use AI tools for code generation, refactoring, test writing, documentation, and code review
- Develop and maintain custom AI-powered developer tools, automations, and internal platforms
- Establish guardrails, security practices, and governance for responsible AI usage in engineering
Technical Documentation & Mentorship
- Influence engineering culture by evangelizing AI-first development practices across teams
- Train and upskill team members on effective use of AI tools, LLM integration patterns, and ML best practices
- Contribute to internal knowledge bases, tech talks, and communities of practice
- Partner with product, design, and data science teams to identify and deliver AI-driven opportunities
- Participate in architecture reviews and design discussions, ensuring AI solutions are production-ready from day one

Required Qualifications
- Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on AI/ML solution development and delivery
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or related field (or equivalent experience)
- AI/ML Expertise:- Strong understanding of large language model architectures, capabilities, and limitations
- Proven track record building and deploying production AI systems (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, embeddings, vector search)
- Proficiency with AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex)
- Hands-on experience with major LLM providers and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock)
- Solid understanding of prompt engineering, evaluation methodologies, and AI safety/guardrails

- Programming: Expert-level proficiency in Python; strong skills in at least one additional language (Java, TypeScript/Node.js, C#/.NET)
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
- Data: Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, ChromaDB), and data pipeline tools
- API Development: Proven track record building production APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and event-driven integrations
- AI Tools Proficiency: Advanced daily usage of AI coding assistants with demonstrated impact on productivity and code quality
- Testing: Strong testing practices for AI systems including model evaluation, integration testing, and automated quality checks
- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain complex AI concepts to diverse audiences

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience building enterprise AI platforms serving multiple product teams
- Familiarity with custom model training, fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), and RLHF techniques
- Experience with agent-based AI architectures and autonomous multi-step workflows
- Knowledge of AI security concerns (prompt injection, data leakage, model poisoning) and mitigation strategies
- Experience in regulated industries (insurance, finance, healthcare) with security and compliance requirements
- Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published technical content
- Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent)
- Experience with real-time inference, streaming responses, and low-latency AI serving architectures

title: Fullstack Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.
  
  
Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.
  
  
Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.
  
  
We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).
  
  
**About Diagrid**
At Diagrid, we're building the infrastructure that helps developers build, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable applications.
  
  
Built on the foundation of Dapr, the CNCF-graduated open-source project, Diagrid is helping engineering teams simplify the complexity of distributed systems. As AI transforms how software is built and operated, we're extending that mission to help developers take AI agents from experimentation to production with confidence.
  
  
We're a globally distributed team of engineers and builders who care deeply about solving complex technical problems, contributing to open source, and creating products developers love.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a talented
**Fullstack Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript experience**
to join our growing AI & DevEx team, led by Casper Nielsen.
  
  
You'll help build the next generation of Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer tools, working across backend services, APIs, and user-facing applications.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building products end-to-end, solving complex technical challenges, and working in a fast-moving startup environment.
  
  
You'll work closely with engineering and product leadership to turn ideas into production-ready capabilities, with a focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build end-to-end product features: Design, develop, and maintain fullstack applications using TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks.
* Develop scalable backend services: Build APIs, integrations, and services that power Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer-facing products.
* Work on AI infrastructure: Help develop the tools and services that enable developers to build, deploy, manage, and operate AI agents reliably in production.
* Own features from concept to production: Participate in technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements.
* Create great developer experiences: Build intuitive interfaces, APIs, and workflows that make complex distributed systems easier to use.
* Collaborate across teams: Work closely with AI, platform, product, and engineering teams to solve technical challenges and deliver customer value.
* Champion engineering quality: Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, contribute to architectural decisions, and continuously improve engineering practices.
* Solve challenging technical problems: Work on distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, integrations, and the reliability challenges that come with production AI applications.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Strong professional experience developing production applications with TypeScript and Node.js.
* Experience building modern web applications using React or a similar frontend framework.
* Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and service integrations.
* Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud-native development, containerization, and modern deployment practices.
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Ability to independently own technical projects and deliver high-quality solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in an environment where requirements evolve.
* Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams.
* A product mindset and genuine interest in understanding the problems developers and customers are trying to solve.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered applications, AI agents, or LLM integrations.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks, orchestration tools, or agent development patterns.
* Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or microservices.
* Knowledge of Dapr, Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with real-time systems, messaging, or asynchronous workflows.
* Contributions to open-source projects or experience working with developer-focused products.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth technology startup.

**Working Hours**
**Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America.**
**Our India team’s day typically starts around 12:00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You’ll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8:30 PM to 12:00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly.**
What Makes This Opportunity Exciting
  
  
**Build at the intersection of AI and distributed systems.**
Work on real engineering challenges involved in making AI agents reliable, secure, and production-ready.
  
  
**Make a meaningful impact.**
Join a growing engineering team where your ideas, technical decisions, and contributions directly influence the products we build.
  
  
**Own what you build.**
Take responsibility for features end-to-end, from initial design through production and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Work with experienced engineers.**
Collaborate with a globally distributed team building infrastructure for the next generation of software.
  
  
**Help shape what's next.**
Be part of an ambitious company working at the forefront of cloud-native and AI application development.
  
  
**Diagrid Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Company equity
* Remote first & flexible work environment
* Flexible paid time off
* Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents
* Choice of hardware
* $1000 for home office setup
* Monthly WFH stipend
* Team events & gatherings
* Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures

* Third-party API integration, secure session handling, SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, PDF generation and reliable export workflows.
* Automated testing and debugging across the browser, backend and AI services; Git, code review, deployment pipelines, Docker or equivalent packaging, and one cloud environment.

**Preferred Experience**
Absorb or another LMS; LTI 1.3, OIDC/SSO or secure external-tool launches; multi-tenant SaaS; rubric-based AI evaluation; training/coaching products; insurance workflows; document retrieval; and integrations with Sheets, BigQuery, HubSpot or Zapier. Europe.

We are seeking a Lead Frontend Engineer to be the technical anchor for our frontend capability. This role goes beyond feature delivery; you will define the frontend architecture, establish the component design system, own the Next.js application structure, drive performance standards, and mentor senior and mid-level frontend engineers. You will build the most complex, data-intensive UI surfaces: real-time attribution dashboards, AI-powered campaign builders, and platform-embedded intelligence widgets, all in a React + Next.js stack integrated with Elasticsearch-powered search and streaming AI responses.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the frontend architecture: Next.js App Router structure, component boundaries, state management strategy (Redux), and data-fetching patterns applying hexagonal UI principles where the component layer is decoupled from specific backend service contracts.
* Design and build the most technically complex UI surfaces: real-time attribution dashboards (streaming data), AI-powered campaign builder (LLM response streaming), Elasticsearch-backed customer search with faceted filtering, and platform-embedded opportunity cards.
* Define the component design system: Atomic component library, theming contracts, accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1), and Storybook-based documentation.
* Establish frontend performance standards: Core Web Vitals targets, bundle size budgets, SSR/SSG strategy with Next.js, lazy loading, and virtualisation for large data tables.
* Lead Next.js architecture decisions: App Router vs. Pages Router tradeoffs, RSC (React Server Components) applicability, streaming SSR for AI-generated content, and API route design.
* Integrate AI-native frontend patterns: streaming LLM responses into UI components, real-time score updates from Redis/Aerospike via SSE, and Elasticsearch typeahead search.
* Drive code quality through design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and frontend-specific engineering standards.
* Mentor senior and mid-level frontend engineers, setting the bar for component design, test coverage, and performance discipline.
* Collaborate closely with backend staff engineers to define API contracts and with designers to implement pixel-perfect, accessible UIs.

**Requirements:**

* 8+ years of frontend engineering experience with deep React and Next.js expertise in production systems.
* Mastery of Next.js 14+ App Router, React Server Components, streaming SSR, and static generation, knowing when to apply each pattern.
* Strong TypeScript expertise: type safety across component props, API contracts, Redux store shape, and server/client boundaries.
* Deep Redux expertise: slice design, selector optimisation, middleware patterns, and RTK Query for data fetching.
* Proven experience building data-intensive dashboards with real-time data (WebSocket, SSE, or polling) and chart libraries (Recharts, D3.js ).
* Experience integrating Elasticsearch-powered search UIs: typeahead, faceted search, and result ranking display.
* Strong frontend performance engineering: bundle analysis, code splitting, memoisation, virtualisation, and Core Web Vitals optimisation.
* Experience in establishing and maintaining component design systems with accessibility standards.
* Must have proven experience leading front-end development teams, mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across a frontend team.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience streaming LLM/AI-generated content into React UI components (token streaming, partial rendering patterns).
* Familiarity with platform-embedded micro-frontend patterns (module federation or iframe-based embedding).
* Background in automotive retail, eCommerce analytics, or SaaS BI/reporting platforms.
* Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual regression testing.

As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Build Distributed Systems at Global Scale — Join Harness Feature Management & Experimentation (FME)**
Last year, the Harness FME platform evaluated
**4 trillion feature flags**
. For most people, that’s just an impressive number. For a scale-minded builder and engineering leader, it represents one of the most demanding challenges in distributed systems.

* Millisecond-level latency through a globally distributed feature flag delivery network.
* Tier-one enterprise reliability trusted by the world’s most sophisticated companies.

**About You**

* 8-11 years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Go, C++ and Java.
* Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management, CPU/process architecture, containers, cgroups, and filesystems.
* Strong experience designing and building scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL (including pgx driver), Redis, and object storage systems such as S3.
* Solid experience working within AWS environments and familiarity with core cloud infrastructure concepts including VPCs, load balancers, auto scaling, and compute instances. Exposure to Azure or GCP is a plus.
* Experience building and operating cloud-native applications using Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and related orchestration tooling.
* Strong understanding of API design and backend communication patterns, including
* REST APIs, gRPC, and middleware frameworks such as gorilla/mux and alice.
* Proficient with Git-based development workflows and modern software delivery practices.
* Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues beyond application code.

**Nice-to-have**

* Contributions to open-source projects.

* Experience building a transformative product
* End-to-end ownership of your projects
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefit
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

description:
**About Artha Group**

Artha Group is a performance-first investment house managing 2,300 crores across domestic and international investment vehicles, including Category I II AIFs, LLPs, and Private Limited companies. With active investments in 130+ startups, with 32+ successful exits, and 10+ renewable energy projects. We operate at the convergence of capital precision and operational depth.

**Role Overview**

Artha Group is seeking an Analyst - Full Stack Engineer to join its internal Tech team as a full-time hire. You will build and ship the web applications, internal tools and workflow automations that the firm s teams run on, working primarily in Next.js, with clean code and a systems mindset rather than one-off fixes.

This is a hands-on engineering role with an analyst s instinct. You will understand how a process actually works before you automate it, and you will design for the people who use it. Our users come from many different backgrounds, so what you build has to be intuitive, accessible and clear to people with very different levels of technical comfort. You will own what you ship through to adoption and improvement. We welcome engineers at the start of their careers as well as those with a few years of experience. What matters is the quality of what you have built and how you think, not only the number of years behind you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Development**

* Experience in building Conversational Video/Audio Platforms
* Write clean, readable, well-tested code that other engineers can maintain and extend.
* Own what you build through release, monitoring and ongoing improvement.

**User-Centred Design and Adoption**

* Design interfaces and flows for audiences from multiple and diverse backgrounds, ensuring tools are intuitive, accessible and usable without training.
* Apply a consumer-grade standard of usability to internal products, so adoption comes from the experience and not from mandates.
* Gather feedback from real users, observe how they actually use what you build, and turn it into prioritised improvements.

**Internal Tooling and Workflow Automation**

* Build internal tools and automations that replace manual, repetitive and spreadsheet-driven processes across teams.
* Develop pipeline and tracking systems that give teams reliable visibility into their work.
* Integrate internal tools with existing systems and data sources, so information flows without re-entry.

**Systems Thinking and Code Quality**

* Think in systems: model data, workflows and integrations deliberately, and weigh trade-offs between speed, maintainability and scale.
* Make sound design decisions for tools that must be both robust and easy for non-technical users.
* Refactor and improve existing systems proactively rather than letting technical debt accumulate.

**Requirements Analysis and Stakeholder Partnership**

* Work directly with internal teams to understand their processes, pain points and goals, and translate them into clear technical solutions.
* Define requirements and success measures before building, and validate outcomes after release.

**Documentation and Reliability**

* Maintain clear documentation for the systems, tools and workflows you build.
* Handle confidential financial, portfolio and people data with discretion, and build tools with access controls, permissions and data protection designed in from the start.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 0 to 4 years of hands-on engineering experience, through professional roles, internships or substantial personal and open-source projects, with a track record of building and shipping real applications.
* Hands-on experience with Next.js and React, with strong fundamentals in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Strong fundamentals in writing clean, maintainable code, and the ability to think in systems.
* Experience building D2C or consumer-facing products is valued, as we hold our internal tools to the same standard of intuitive, self-explanatory design.
* Ability to translate loosely defined business needs into well-scoped technical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work comfortably with non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in internal tooling, workflow automation or product-adjacent engineering is preferred, as is experience building mobile applications.
* A background in HR tech, ATS platforms or applicant tracking pipelines is a meaningful differentiator, as a part of the roadmap includes the systems that support our hiring, talent and people workflows.

**Compensation**

* Total Annual Package: 12,00,000 (12 LPA)
* Fixed Annual Salary: 10,00,000
* Annual Retention Bonus: 2,00,000, paid at the end of each year

title: Analyst - Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Artha Group**

Artha Group is a performance-first investment house managing 2,300 crores across domestic and international investment vehicles, including Category I & II AIFs, LLPs, and Private Limited companies. With active investments in 130+ startups, with 32+ successful exits, and 10+ renewable energy projects. We operate at the convergence of capital precision and operational depth.

**Role Overview**

Artha Group is seeking an Analyst - Full Stack Engineer to join its internal Tech team as a full-time hire. You will build and ship the web applications, internal tools and workflow automations that the firm s teams run on, working primarily in Next.js, with clean code and a systems mindset rather than one-off fixes.

This is a hands-on engineering role with an analyst s instinct. You will understand how a process actually works before you automate it, and you will design for the people who use it. Our users come from many different backgrounds, so what you build has to be intuitive, accessible and clear to people with very different levels of technical comfort. You will own what you ship through to adoption and improvement. We welcome engineers at the start of their careers as well as those with a few years of experience. What matters is the quality of what you have built and how you think, not only the number of years behind you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Development**

* Experience in building Conversational Video/Audio Platforms
* Write clean, readable, well-tested code that other engineers can maintain and extend.
* Own what you build through release, monitoring and ongoing improvement.

**User-Centred Design and Adoption**

* Design interfaces and flows for audiences from multiple and diverse backgrounds, ensuring tools are intuitive, accessible and usable without training.
* Apply a consumer-grade standard of usability to internal products, so adoption comes from the experience and not from mandates.
* Gather feedback from real users, observe how they actually use what you build, and turn it into prioritised improvements.

**Internal Tooling and Workflow Automation**

* Build internal tools and automations that replace manual, repetitive and spreadsheet-driven processes across teams.
* Develop pipeline and tracking systems that give teams reliable visibility into their work.
* Integrate internal tools with existing systems and data sources, so information flows without re-entry.

**Systems Thinking and Code Quality**

* Think in systems: model data, workflows and integrations deliberately, and weigh trade-offs between speed, maintainability and scale.
* Make sound design decisions for tools that must be both robust and easy for non-technical users.
* Refactor and improve existing systems proactively rather than letting technical debt accumulate.

**Requirements Analysis and Stakeholder Partnership**

* Work directly with internal teams to understand their processes, pain points and goals, and translate them into clear technical solutions.
* Define requirements and success measures before building, and validate outcomes after release.

**Documentation and Reliability**

* Maintain clear documentation for the systems, tools and workflows you build.
* Handle confidential financial, portfolio and people data with discretion, and build tools with access controls, permissions and data protection designed in from the start.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 0 to 4 years of hands-on engineering experience, through professional roles, internships or substantial personal and open-source projects, with a track record of building and shipping real applications.
* Hands-on experience with Next.js and React, with strong fundamentals in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Strong fundamentals in writing clean, maintainable code, and the ability to think in systems.
* Experience building D2C or consumer-facing products is valued, as we hold our internal tools to the same standard of intuitive, self-explanatory design.
* Ability to translate loosely defined business needs into well-scoped technical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work comfortably with non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in internal tooling, workflow automation or product-adjacent engineering is preferred, as is experience building mobile applications.
* A background in HR tech, ATS platforms or applicant tracking pipelines is a meaningful differentiator, as a part of the roadmap includes the systems that support our hiring, talent and people workflows.

**Compensation**

* Total Annual Package: 12,00,000 (12 LPA)
* Fixed Annual Salary: 10,00,000
* Annual Retention Bonus: 2,00,000, paid at the end of each year

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.

About the Mansort Team

The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.

We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.

Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.

Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.

As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.

Key job responsibilities
Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.

Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.

Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation.

Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies.

Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions.

Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience.

Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization.

Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability.

Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab
description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite

Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab 

The ED&T Innovation Lab is Stryker’s one front door for internal, non-commercial problems across our five business units and central functions. We run focused prototype sprints on real problems with real users and approved data, show progress in weekly demos and decide on evidence: stop, refine or scale. A fast, well-reasoned no is a successful outcome. What scales moves to a named delivery owner with a full handoff package; the Lab never keeps a product long term, and never bypasses Enterprise Architecture, security, compliance or QMS governance. Our promise: “Bring us the problem. We’ll test the possibility. Together we scale what works.” 

We are hiring Lead Full Stack Engineer in India as founding engineers of the Lab’s build team. This is a builder’s role with a scout’s curiosity: you will take ideas from a blank repo to a working demo in days or weeks, and spend real time researching, testing and experimenting with emerging technology so the Lab always knows what is possible next. You will report to the Senior Director, ED&T Innovation Lab, and work in a small, hands-on team across the US and India. 

What you will do:
- Own full-stack prototypes from first commit to working demo in 2–8-week sprints, spanning front end, APIs, services, data, cloud deployment and AI.
- Bring ideas to life through minimally functional prototypes tested by real users on real business problems with approved data, showcasing progress in weekly demos.
- Build AI-powered solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, tool calling, copilots, automation, and intelligent document and email processing.
- Explore emerging technologies—from AI and agents to automation, digital twins and quantum—and run time-boxed experiments, proofs of concept and technology comparisons to separate capability from hype.
- Shape technical direction for your prototypes: define architecture, break down delivery, assess existing Stryker capabilities for reuse and make evidence-based build-or-kill decisions, recognising a well-reasoned no as a successful outcome.
- Accelerate the Lab’s engineering foundations with reusable starter kits, components, templates, CI/CD pipelines and sandbox patterns, while maintaining clean code, targeted testing, secure defaults and practical documentation.
- Stay hands-on while reviewing code, pairing with and mentoring engineers, and partnering with the Lab leader to shape technical direction.
- Partner with business stakeholders and Business Innovation Partners to translate problems into buildable scope, clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria.
- Turn experimentation into shared insight through concise write-ups, demos, contributions to the Lab’s quarterly innovation radar for ED&T leadership and your own experiment ideas; capture what worked, what did not, and the cost and effort to scale.
- Equip delivery teams to scale validated prototypes with a complete handoff covering architecture, data, security context and next steps, working within Enterprise Architecture, cybersecurity, data privacy and QMS guardrails from day one.

What you need 
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 5–8 years of professional software engineering experience in delivering full-stack web applications end to end. A relevant master’s degree is a plus.
- Strong front-end expertise in React and TypeScript, or a comparable modern framework such as Angular, combined with back-end development in .NET/C#, Node.js or Python, RESTful APIs, and SQL and NoSQL data modelling.
- Hands-on cloud-native development and deployment experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure App Service, Functions, containers, storage and identity. Azure certifications and enterprise integration experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, SAP, Power Platform and Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on are advantages.
- Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG, agents or copilots, using Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs or similar technologies. Experience with Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.
- A proven ability to turn concepts into working demos in days or weeks. Experience in an innovation lab, R&D group, startup, rapid product team or software-product company, alongside sustained impact and multi-year ownership across roles, will help you stand out.
- Solid engineering foundations in Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker and secure coding, with effective daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and sound judgement on code review and quality.
- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners and deliver confident demos. Ability to collaborate with a US-based team, including regular US Eastern Time overlap for demos, stand-ups and partner sessions.
- Preferred strengths include curiosity demonstrated through open-source contributions, side projects, hackathon wins, technical writing or talks; exposure to computer vision, speech, IoT and edge, digital twins, AR/VR or quantum computing; and experience in healthcare, medical devices or other regulated industries.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to own the technical direction of our global web platform, built on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Sites and AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS). You will lead the move of high-volume marketing properties onto EDS, keep our core AEM estate healthy and scalable, and bring AI into how the team designs, builds, tests and ships — not as a talking point, but as part of everyday engineering practice.
This role sits at the intersection of architecture, delivery and people leadership. You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, eCommerce, MarTech, Compliance and Analytics teams, and guide both internal engineers and contractor partners.

Job Description
Platform architecture & technical leadership
- Architecture ownership: Own the end-to-end architecture across AEM as a Cloud Service and EDS — including the decision framework for which properties belong on each, and how they coexist (CDN routing, shared design system, shared integrations).
- EDS migration: Lead migration and creation of sites / microsites and marketing pages to EDS, with a focus on performance, authoring simplicity and lower run cost.
- Engineering standards: Set coding standards, review designs and code, and make the hard technical trade-offs between speed, quality and maintainability.
- Integrations: Guide integrations with commerce (e.g., SAP Hybris), search (e.g., Algolia), Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target/CDP, Marketo, Salesforce and tag management (GTM), plus consent/compliance tooling.
AI-enabled development
- AI in the workflow: Actively use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to accelerate component and block development, refactoring, documentation and test creation — and set team guidelines for using them safely and well.
- Prompt engineering: Design and refine prompts, prompt templates and lightweight agents/automations for repeatable engineering and content tasks (e.g., content migration, page/block scaffolding, metadata and alt-text generation, QA checks).
- AI-powered features: Support AI-driven experiences on the site, such as conversational/concierge assistants, AI-assisted search and personalization — including API integration, guardrails, and evaluation of output quality.
- Responsible use: Bring a clear point of view on where AI should assist, accelerate or automate — and where it should not — with attention to security, privacy, IP and regulatory compliance.
Delivery, quality & people
- Delivery: Lead a team of developers (internal and partner), plan sprints with Product, and deliver predictable releases against time-bound commitments such as global launches and events.
- Quality & performance: Build an automation-first quality approach: unit tests, Playwright (or similar) end-to-end tests, Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals performance budgets in CI/CD, and accessibility checks (WCAG 2.1 AA).
- DevOps & operations: Own Cloud Manager pipelines, environments, release management and production support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.
- Mentoring & influence: Mentor engineers, grow EDS and AI skills across the team, and act as the technical voice in conversations with business stakeholders and leadership.
What You Bring
Required
- 10–14 years of web/software engineering experience, with at least 8+ years on Adobe AEM (Sites, ideally AEM as a Cloud Service) and 2+ years in a technical lead or architect role.
- Hands-on experience building on AEM Edge Delivery Services — blocks, document-based or Universal Editor authoring, aem.live tooling, and performance tuning.
- Strong core AEM skills: Java, OSGi, Sling Models, HTL, Core Components, Dispatcher, content and component architecture, multi-site/multi-language management (MSM).
- Strong front-end skills: modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- Demonstrated, practical use of AI tools in day-to-day development, plus solid prompt-design skills — able to show real examples of what you built or sped up with AI.
- Experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs, headless delivery, and third-party platforms (search, commerce, analytics, marketing automation).
- CI/CD and Git experience (Adobe Cloud Manager, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), and comfort with Agile/Scrum delivery.
- Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and influence without direct authority.
Nice to have
- Adobe certifications (AEM Sites Developer / Architect).
- Experience with Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics/CJA, Real-Time CDP or AEM Assets/Dynamic Media.
- Experience with Algolia or other search platforms, and with SAP Commerce (Hybris) integrations.
- Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI), RAG patterns, or agentic workflows.
- Background in regulated industries (healthcare, life sciences, financial services) — consent management, privacy and compliance tooling such as Evidon and GTM governance.
- Experience migrating from other CMS platforms (Sitecore, WordPress) to AEM.
What Success Looks Like in Year One
- A clear AEM-vs-EDS architecture and migration roadmap, with first priority properties live on EDS and measurable gains in page performance and authoring speed.
- AI-assisted development practices adopted across the team, with documented guidelines and visible improvements in delivery speed and quality.
- Automated testing and performance checks running in the release pipeline, reducing defects and manual QA effort.
- A stronger, more self-sufficient engineering team, less dependent on individual experts.

Additional Information
